WITH scada AS (
    SELECT
        SETTLEMENTDATE,
        DUID,
        SCADAVALUE,
        INTERVAL_MWH
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/*.parquet',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS s
),

du AS (
    SELECT
        DUID,
        REGIONID
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/DU_DETAIL_SUMMARY/*.parquet',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS d
),

region_sum AS (
    SELECT
        SETTLEMENTDATE,
        REGIONID,
        TOTALDEMAND,
        NET_DEMAND,
        GENERATION_MARGIN
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/DISPATCH_REGION_SUM/*.parquet',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS r
),

trading_price AS (
    SELECT
        SETTLEMENTDATE,
        REGIONID,
        RRP,
        PRICE_STATUS
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/TRADING_PRICE/*.parquet',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS t
),

consumer AS (
    SELECT
        s.SETTLEMENTDATE,
        s.DUID,
        d.REGIONID,
        s.SCADAVALUE,
        s.INTERVAL_MWH,
        r.TOTALDEMAND,
        r.NET_DEMAND,
        r.GENERATION_MARGIN,
        t.RRP,
        t.PRICE_STATUS
    FROM scada AS s

    LEFT JOIN du AS d
        on s.DUID = d.DUID
    
    LEFT JOIN region_sum AS r
        ON d.REGIONID = r.REGIONID
        AND s.SETTLEMENTDATE = r.SETTLEMENTDATE

    LEFT JOIN trading_price AS t
        ON d.REGIONID = t.REGIONID
        AND s.SETTLEMENTDATE = t.SETTLEMENTDATE
)

SELECT 
    SETTLEMENTDATE,
    REGIONID,
    COUNT(*) AS RECORD_COUNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DUID) AS UNIT_COUNT,
    SUM(INTERVAL_MWH) AS TOTAL_INTERVAL_MWH,
    AVG(SCADAVALUE) AS AVG_SCADA_VALUE,
    MAX(TOTALDEMAND) AS TOTALDEMAND,
    MAX(NET_DEMAND) AS NET_DEMAND,
    MAX(GENERATION_MARGIN) AS REGION_GENERATION_MARGIN,
    MAX(RRP) AS RRP,
    SUM(INTERVAL_MWH) * MAX(RRP) AS ESTIMATED_INTERVAL_VALUE

FROM consumer
GROUP BY
    SETTLEMENTDATE,
    REGIONID;
